user.title: Telegram API credentials
user.description: Enter your Telegram API ID and API Hash. If Telegram is blocked or unstable on this network, enable a proxy connection.

data_description.proxy_enabled: Connect to Telegram through a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy.
data_description.proxy_host: Hostname or IP address of the proxy server.
data_description.proxy_username: Optional. Fill in only if your proxy requires authentication.
data_description.proxy_password: Optional. Fill in only if your proxy requires authentication.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: Enter your phone number in international format.

password.title: Two-step verification
password.description: Enter your Telegram two-step verification password.

enter_code.title: Re-authentication for {phone}
enter_code.description: Enter the verification code sent to {phone}.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Configure the automatic response and message filters.

data_description.ignored_users: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs or usernames to ignore.
data_description.response_text: Message that will be sent automatically.
data_description.cooldown: Time window in minutes for limiting repeated responses. Use 0 to disable the cooldown window.
data_description.max_msgs: Maximum number of automatic responses allowed within the cooldown window.
data_description.allow_group_chats: Allow the auto-responder to reply in groups and megagroups.
data_description.allow_channels: Allow the auto-responder to reply in channels when permissions allow it.
data_description.allow_bots: Allow replies to messages from bot accounts.
data_description.test_message: Send a message to Saved Messages when the auto-responder starts or stops.

error.send_code_failed: Failed to send the verification code
error.session_save_failed: Failed to save the Telegram session
error.invalid_cooldown: Cooldown must be between 0 and 1440 minutes
error.invalid_max_messages: Maximum responses must be between 1 and 1000
error.min_cooldown: Cooldown must be at least 0 minutes
error.max_cooldown: Maximum cooldown is 1440 minutes, or 24 hours
error.value_too_low: The value must be no less than {min_value}
error.value_too_high: The value must be no more than {max_value}
error.value_out_of_range: The value is outside the allowed range
error.integer_too_large: Number is too large, maximum is {max_value}
error.proxy_host_required: Proxy host is required when proxy is enabled
error.invalid_proxy_port: Proxy port must be an integer from 1 to 65535
